summary: An OTP input component for secure verification code entry.
shortDescription: The Input OTP component provides a specialized interface for entering one-time passwords and verification codes. It displays individual character input cells that auto-advance focus as users type, with support for paste handling of complete codes. Commonly used in authentication flows, two-factor verification, and account confirmation processes where security codes need to be entered with minimal friction.
